"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America’s national work over the next two years will particularly concern the time and resources of national staff.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America’s national work over the next two years will particularly concern the elected national political leadership.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A nationally coordinated campaign, with the national staff and National Political Committee (NPC) supplying relevant guidance, literature and political education, in favor of both national and state-level Medicare for All and single-payer legislative bills and citizen initiatives (where possible) would provide DSA chapters the ability to campaign for a transformative working-class demand.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Medicare for All and single-payer legislative bills and citizen initiatives (where possible) would socialize the health insurance industry.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The issue of universal health care could inform the 2018 and 2020 elections.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Left could challenge both the hegemonic Right and the neoliberal Democratic establishment around socializing a basic human need in the 2018 and 2020 elections.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The establishment of a functioning Democratic Socialist Labor Commission would enhance DSA’s ability to both work for a democratic labor movement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The establishment of labor branches in as many locals as possible would enhance DSA’s ability to both work for a democratic labor movement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The establishment of a functioning Democratic Socialist Labor Commission and labor branches in as many locals as possible would enhance DSA’s ability to recruit politically active poor and working-class people into DSA.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The establishment of a functioning Democratic Socialist Labor Commission and labor branches in as many locals as possible would enhance DSA’s ability to recruit disabled comrades into DSA.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
